label: row_0
context: Peroxyl radicals abstract allylic and doubly allylic C–H bonds far more rapidly than non-conjugated alkenes because conjugation stabilizes the resulting carbon radical. The trend matches biological autoxidation and lipoxygenase catalysis, where allylic radical stabilization controls selectivity.
